diagnosis.what_happened: Revisions were only partially applied due to selective patching, leaving identical errors unresolved elsewhere in the document.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Reliance on local index patching instead of systematic global document audits and lack of visible verification.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Agents should have performed document-wide search-and-replace, used explicit yellow highlight marking for pre-existing verified items, and ensured 100% complete execution of all comments.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Thesis revisions require absolute consistency. Leaving partial errors invalidates the revision process, damages academic credibility, and leads to rejection.

desired_behavior: Mandate document-wide search-and-replace. Use explicit yellow highlight marking for pre-existing verified items to prove coverage. Ensure 100% complete execution of all comments across all sections.
generalization: All text revisions targeting specific errors must execute exhaustively across the entire document corpus with visible verification trails.

evidence.observed_value: Partial application of comments via selective index
evidence.threshold_value: 100% application across all relevant document sections
